verdict.rationale: A probe shows that a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at nextjs.org/openapi.json: it returned HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. No first-party docs say what API it describes, how complete it is, or that it is maintained, so only its existence is proven. The llms.txt and docs.md probes show machine-readable docs, which is adjacent and not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the spec and its scope, evidence of endpoint coverage and completeness, independent or hands-on corroboration of usefulness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
